title: Impact of the Coronavirus (COVID-19) on Patients With Cancer
official: Impact of the Coronavirus (COVID-19) on Patients With Cancer
summary: The purpose of this study is to understand the impact of COVID-19 on patients with cancer through a survey.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. The patients must be 18 years or older.
2. Patients who opt in to complete the survey.
3. Patients must have the capacity to verbally consent for the interview.

Exclusion Criteria:

1.Patients who under the age of 18 years old.
